title: Baan Talay Work & Dive Villa
tagline: Dedicated fiber workspace & private plunge pool nestled in a serene cul-de-sac

reviews.author: Liam K.
reviews.text: Stayed for two weeks while working European hours. The fiber Wi-Fi clocked 185 Mbps down / 90 Mbps up consistently, and the ergonomic chair in the study saved my back during 4-hour Zoom marathons.

reviews.author: Priya M.
reviews.text: Dead quiet at night since it's tucked in a cul-de-sac away from the main beach road. Fast 5-minute scooter ride to Aqua Vision Dive Center for morning boat departures.

reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Only minor downside is you are a 15-minute drive from the busy Ao Nang nightlife, so you definitely need to rent a scooter or use Grab for dinner variety.

title: Ao Nang Pierfront Loft Studio
tagline: Steps from longtail boat departures and PADI dive centers with ocean views

reviews.author: Elena R.
reviews.text: Unbeatable location for scuba divers! Three PADI 5-star dive shops are literally downstairs, and the longtail boat pickup for the islands is a 3-minute walk across the street.

reviews.author: David S.
reviews.text: Do NOT book this if you need to take work calls or sleep before midnight. The live music bar across the alley blasts bass until 1:00 AM, and the shared hotel Wi-Fi dropped twice during my team standup.

reviews.author: Hannah W.
reviews.text: Great value for $72 and super clean, plus there is a dedicated outdoor rinse tank on the ground floor for washing wetsuit gear.

title: Railay Limestone Cliff Bungalow
tagline: Tranquil car-free peninsula sanctuary flanked by dramatic limestone karst cliffs

reviews.author: Noah B.
reviews.text: Zero cars or motorbikes on the Railay peninsula, so you wake up only to birds and limestone cliff views. Railay Dive Center is an easy 8-minute walk along the boardwalk.

reviews.author: Chloe G.
reviews.text: Wi-Fi is fine for emails and Netflix (around 25 Mbps), but during heavy tropical rainstorms the peninsula connection lags. Also, there's only a low coffee table—no proper desk for laptop work.

reviews.author: Julian S.
reviews.text: Absolute heaven if you want to unplug, read, and kayak between sea arches. Just be prepared to carry luggage on foot since there are no road vehicles on Railay.

title: Chalong Bay Diver's Sanctuary & Co-Work
tagline: Purpose-built base for working scuba divers with 24/7 monitors and pier convenience

reviews.author: Arjun V.
reviews.text: Purpose-built for working divers. You are a 3-minute walk from Chalong Pier where all the Phi Phi and Racha day boats depart at 7:30 AM. I finished a 3-dive day by 4 PM and hopped straight onto evening product calls with 200 Mbps fiber.

reviews.author: Sophie L.
reviews.text: Super quiet bedrooms with double-glazed glass and a 24/7 co-working lounge on the 2nd floor with external monitors you can plug into.

reviews.author: Ben C.
reviews.text: Note that Chalong Bay has boats, not a swimming beach—you'll need a 12-minute taxi to Kata or Nai Harn if you want soft sand beach lounging.

title: Rawai Hillside Infinity Villa
tagline: Panoramic sea views, ultra-fast 300 Mbps fiber, and dual monitors on a quiet hillside

reviews.author: Karin M.
reviews.text: The fastest internet I've ever experienced in Southeast Asia—tested at 310 Mbps symmetric. Hosted a 6-person sprint review with zero packet loss or lag.

reviews.author: Tariq A.
reviews.text: Total peace and bird songs up on the hill. However, the driveway is steep—you definitely need a 150cc scooter or rental car. About 10 minutes drive down to Chalong Pier for morning boat trips.

reviews.author: Amara K.
reviews.text: Sunset from the infinity pool is breathtaking. Kitchen is well-equipped for longer stays if you want to cook your own meals.

title: Kata Beachfront Surf & Digital Haven
tagline: Surf breaks and golden sands at your doorstep with casual cafe co-working vibes

reviews.author: Lucas P.
reviews.text: Step directly onto Kata Beach! Perfect if your priority is catching morning waves or sunset cocktails. The on-site cafe has great iced espresso.

reviews.author: Maya N.
reviews.text: Wi-Fi is adequate for Slack and documents (45 Mbps), but during lunch rush the cafe router struggled with heavy upload tasks. Moderate street chatter until 11 PM.

reviews.author: Felix H.
reviews.text: If you are doing daily dive trips out of Chalong Pier, keep in mind it's a 20-minute taxi ride each way across the Kata hill, which adds $15-20 per day in Grab costs.
